Common questions about Meetily's patient privacy, HIPAA compliance, and session documentation features

children.q: How does Meetily ensure patient privacy and HIPAA compliance?
children.a: Meetily ensures complete patient privacy through local processing architecture - all data stays on your device. With zero-knowledge architecture and end-to-end encryption, session recordings and notes remain strictly confidential and HIPAA compliant.

children.q: Can Meetily be used for therapy sessions?
children.a: Yes, Meetily is ideal for therapy sessions. It provides secure, HIPAA-compliant documentation while maintaining complete patient confidentiality. The system handles individual sessions, group therapy, and consultations with full privacy protection.

children.q: How does local processing protect patient information?
children.a: Local processing means all data processing happens within your own device or infrastructure, not on external servers. This ensures complete control over patient information, meeting HIPAA's privacy and security requirements. No patient data ever leaves your secure environment.

children.q: What security measures protect patient confidentiality?
children.a: Meetily implements multiple security measures: AES-256 encryption, secure authentication, role-based access control, detailed audit trails, and automatic PII detection and protection. All processing happens locally within your secure environment.

children.q: How does Meetily help with session documentation?
children.a: Meetily provides AI-powered transcription that captures session details while you focus on your patient. The system helps create organized, searchable notes while maintaining strict privacy standards. Features include automatic note structuring, key point highlighting, and secure record keeping.
